title: Consistency witnesses for cardinal characteristics, diamond, and choice
proposed_reference_coverage: Constructibility, forcing and symmetric-model consistency and independence witnesses
fact_or_context_to_reference: Construct actual membership models and extensions realizing specified unequal cardinal-characteristic values or deciding diamond and choice principles differently over their stated axiom systems. Develop the finite-fragment metatheory for full syntactic relative-consistency implications, distinguishing a transitive-ground-model premise from bare consistency.

coverage_plan.pending_coverage: Unequal cardinal-characteristic values, diamond and choice witnesses, and finite-fragment consistency metatheory
coverage_plan.planned_entries_that_supply_it: Later constructibility, suitable cardinal-characteristic forcing and symmetric-model applications, plus the finite-fragment metatheory needed for syntactic relative-consistency implications.
coverage_plan.integration_boundary: The conditional CH calculations can cite actual CTM CH extensions.
